name: @pipeworx/mcp-epo-ops

tools.name: search_patents
tools.description: Search published patents worldwide via EPO OPS and get back full bibliographic records — title, applicants, inventors, publication date, country, IPC classifications — for each hit. Searches EPO DOCDB, which indexes publications from 100+ patent offices, so Chinese, Japanese, Korean, US and PCT/WO documents are all in scope alongside European ones — PCT international applications (publications beginning "WO") are covered here and in every other tool in this pack, not just EP filings. Each hit's `kind` code tells you what stage it is: an "A"-prefixed kind (A1, A2, A3…) is a published APPLICATION, not yet granted; a "B"-prefixed kind (B1, B2…) is a GRANTED patent; a WO publication's "A1"/"A2"/"A3" marks the PCT publication itself, not a grant — PCT applications are examined and granted nationally after entering each country's national phase, which this pack does not track. Results are not filtered to grants by default — most hits from a bare keyword search will be "A" kind. To find issued/granted patents specifically, scope the query with a kind or grant-relevant field (e.g. add `AND pd>=<date>` and check `kind` on the returned rows) rather than assuming an unfiltered hit is granted. Example queries: "ta=hydrogen", "in=Tesla", "pa=apple", "txt=neural network AND pd>=2020", "pa=moderna and pn=WO" (a company's PCT filings).

query.description: EPO CQL — fields: ta (title-abstract), ti (title), ab (abstract), txt (any text), in (inventor), pa (applicant), cl (classification), pn (publication number), ap (application number), pr (priority), pd (publication date), ad (application date).

range.description: Result range "start-end" (1-indexed). Max 100 per page. Default "1-25".

tools.name: get_biblio
tools.description: Bibliographic data for one published patent — title, inventors, applicants, publication date, IPC classifications. Drawn from EPO DOCDB, which covers 100+ patent offices, so Chinese, Japanese, Korean, US and PCT/WO publications resolve as well as European ones. A PCT international application (a "WO" publication number) is answered the same as any other — this is NOT the International Search Report or Written Opinion, which EPO OPS does not carry at all; for those, go to WIPO PATENTSCOPE (patentscope.wipo.int). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code such as the "A" in "CN117928705A" is handled for you.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: INPADOC family — every related patent publication worldwide covering the same underlying invention, which is how you find the Chinese, Japanese, US, European and PCT/WO members of one filing. Returns a member count and the countries covered first, then one row per family member: publication number (with kind and date), application number, and priority claims. A PCT international application is a normal member here — give its "WO" publication number, or (before it has published) a WIPO application number like "PCT/US2024/012345". This does NOT include the International Search Report or Written Opinion of a PCT application — EPO OPS does not carry that document at all; for it, go to WIPO PATENTSCOPE (patentscope.wipo.int). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed. A WIPO-style PCT application number is also accepted before it has published, e.g. "PCT/US2024/012345" — this is resolved to the receiving office's application record and the family it belongs to; if that application number is not yet indexed, the response says so and names the number it tried.

raw.description: Include the raw OPS XML-as-JSON family payload alongside the normalised member list. Off by default — the normalised list has everything most callers need.

tools.name: get_abstract
tools.description: Fetch the abstract text of a published patent from EPO OPS. Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you. Requires _apiKey=consumer_key:consumer_secret.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.

tools.name: get_claims
tools.description: Fetch the full claims text of a published patent from EPO OPS. EPO's full-text collection is narrower than its bibliographic one — European (EP) and PCT (WO) publications have the broadest claims coverage, and a publication outside that collection comes back as found:false naming get_biblio as the route to its title, applicants and abstract. Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you. Requires _apiKey=consumer_key:consumer_secret.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.

tools.name: get_legal_status
tools.description: INPADOC legal status for a patent family, sourced from the EPO's worldwide legal-status database — grant, lapse, opposition, withdrawal, appeal and renewal-fee events as reported by the national/regional offices that know about this filing. Answers "is this patent still in force" and "did it lapse for non-payment of a renewal fee", which get_biblio, get_family and get_claims cannot. A European patent can stay in force in some contracting states while lapsing in others, so events are grouped per publication/country rather than collapsed into one in-force flag — read each member's events to see which jurisdiction a given event applies to. Each event carries an `influence` of "negative" (lapse, withdrawal, refusal, revocation), "positive" (grant, renewal, fee paid) or "neutral" (procedural/informational). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you. Requires _apiKey=consumer_key:consumer_secret.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.
